desc: A Backrooms creature that is a hamster remade as a monster: body of damp brown carpet fabric with yellow wallpaper patches and stitched seams, a pale fluorescent tube lodged on its back like a spine drawn as a solid bar, round ears like torn wallpaper. Pixel art game pet sprite, chibi 2-head-tall, right-facing 3/4 view, full body, clean flat shading with 2-3 tones, small dark eyes with white highlight, no glow, no sparkles, no particles, no ground shadow.
